lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
I carry heavy walls of gray
To keep the crashing tides at bay
A spiral home of calcium and lime
Hiding from the passage of the time
[chorus]
Safe inside the shell I made
Watching as the colors fade
No light can reach this hollow deep
Where I store the secrets that I keep
[verse]
The ocean hums a lullaby
Beneath a dark and distant sky
I trace the ridges with my hand
Far away from shifting golden sand
[chorus]
Safe inside the shell I made
Watching as the colors fade
No light can reach this hollow deep
Where I store the secrets that I keep
[bridge]
Maybe one day I will break the seal
And learn to touch what is truly real
But for now the calcium is strong
Where I have belonged for far too long
[chorus]
Safe inside the shell I made
Watching as the colors fade
No light can reach this hollow deep
Where I store the secrets that I keep
[outro]
